You need to build a vegetube and put a plant in it (eg. Seed Lirma). That will start producing oxygen. When oxygen is high enough, you unlock Food Growers.

While waiting for oxygen to be high enough, you need to open every blue chest (or gold chest) you can find, looking for Space Food. You also need to explore the crashed ships to find more Space Food (and more eggplant seeds and plants). There's a huge cave near the starting location that has sand falling from the top of the opening. That cave is full of iridium to build heaters. If you build a deconstruction chip, you can also find a couple of heaters in crashed ships and deconstruct them to get the resources to build a heater. Once you start making progress on heat, you will unlock Vegetube T2 which makes oxygen a lot faster and unlocks food growers a lot sooner. The Planet Crafter is a 2024
[open-world](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Open-world) [survival game](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Survival_game) developed and published by the French studio Miju Games for [Windows](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Windows). The player character awakens in a crashed spacecraft, tasked with exploring and transforming a barren planet to make it habitable. Gameplay involves gathering resources, building machines, and gradually transforming the environment.
The game was initially created by two developers before the team grew to six members over the course of production. It entered
[early access](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Early_access), on March 24, 2022, and was officially released on April 10, 2024. 

In October 2024, Miju Games released the first additional content pack for the game, titled "Planet Humble". This was followed by "The Moons Update" in May 2025, which added two more celestial objects to terraform, and "Toxicity" in November 2025. In April 2026, Miju Games released the "2.0 update".
The Planet Crafter received generally positive reviews, with critics praising its relaxing open-ended gameplay. The reviewers also criticized the limited map and user-friendliness issues. Player reception was similarly favorable, and the game sold over one million copies by June 2024.
